title: Install a Scheduled Job (cron or systemd timer)
description: Installs a recurring schedule for an existing command -- either a cron entry (via the native cron module) or a systemd timer+service pair -- across your inventory.

variables.name: COMMAND_PATH
variables.prompt: Full path to the script/command to run

variables.name: CRON_SCHEDULE
variables.prompt: Cron schedule, 5 space-separated fields (only used for the cron method)

variables.name: TIMER_ON_CALENDAR
variables.prompt: systemd OnCalendar value, e.g. 'hourly' or '*-*-* 02:00:00' (only used for the systemd timer method)

variables.name: UNIT_NAME
variables.prompt: Name for the systemd service/timer unit (only used for the systemd timer method)

toggle_groups.name: CRON_USER_SCOPE
toggle_groups.prompt: Install into which crontab (only used for the cron method)
